summary: Tested the wa.me WhatsApp deep-link fallback (backend URL construction + frontend popup/Step 3 block) plus full regression of booking/admin flows. Added TestWhatsAppShareUrls (3 tests) to /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py — 29 passed, 1 skipped, 0 failed. Playwright verified: booking submit opens a WhatsApp deep-link popup (wa.me redirects to api.whatsapp.com/send with correct phone + pre-filled text), navigation to /booking/{id}, Step 3 green block with whatsapp-notify-0/1 anchors (hrefs https://wa.me/917483557316 and https://wa.me/919844912006 with encoded booking name/amount/qty/id/status), screenshot upload -> status awaiting verification + share text updates, admin login stellar2026, has_screenshot 'View' link, and confirm updates row to CONFIRMED. All TEST_QA data purged after the run.

minor.issue: Returns only {ok,status} — no whatsapp_share_urls/booking payload, so the frontend must re-GET. Not a defect, just noted; test adjusted to GET after upload.

State-dependent/flaky (~1 in 2 runs) when many held bookings accumulate from parallel workers: assert abs(held - pending_qty) <= 2 failed with 22 vs 16. Passes on a clean bookings collection. Consider making the assertion delta-based instead of absolute.

integration_issues.issue: Works, but note the popup lands on api.whatsapp.com/send (wa.me 302) and WhatsApp's redirect mangles the leading 🌺 emoji to U+FFFD (%EF%BF%BD) in the forwarded text. Anchor hrefs on the confirmation page keep the correct %F0%9F%8C%BA. Cosmetic only; if you want a guaranteed clean message, drop the emoji from the first line of _wa_share_url().

issues: Step 3 WhatsApp block is hidden once status = confirmed (block is inside the !confirmed branch), so a confirmed guest can no longer re-send details — only the small 'Need help' wa.me links remain. Intentional? Otherwise move the block outside the !confirmed conditional.

action_items: Optional: remove leading emoji in _wa_share_url() to avoid U+FFFD mangling via api.whatsapp.com redirect
Optional: decide whether Step 3 WhatsApp block should also show for confirmed bookings
Optional: make test_reject_flow_releases_hold delta-based (flaky on dirty DB)
critical_code_review_comments: _wa_share_url() reads doc['full_name'|'phone'|'email'|'amount'|'status'] with direct indexing — safe today since booking_doc_to_out already assumes them, but any legacy/partial doc would raise 500 on GET /api/bookings/{id}.
ORGANIZER_PHONES has an inline default in code ('+917483...'), which contradicts fail-fast env policy; .env already provides it.
seed_data_creation: Created and then deleted TEST_QA bookings (API + 2 Playwright bookings). Remaining non-test rows untouched: 'Rahul Chavan G' (awaiting_verification) and 'Preview User' (pending).
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py now has TestWhatsAppShareUrls covering POST /api/bookings and GET /api/bookings/{id} whatsapp_share_urls shape (2 organizers, +91 phones, https://wa.me/91..., decoded text contains name/amount/qty/id-8/status). Run `python /app/backend/tests/purge_test_qa.py` before and after pytest — held-slot accumulation makes test_reject_flow_releases_hold flaky. Hidden file input needs state='attached' in Playwright ([data-testid=screenshot-input]). Admin action testids are confirm-{id} / reject-{id} / view-screenshot-{id} / booking-row-{id}.
rca_of_the_issue: No product defect found for the reported WhatsApp gap: backend builds correct wa.me deep links per organizer and the frontend opens the first one inside the click gesture (not popup-blocked in Chromium) plus renders both Notify buttons on the confirmation page. The only failures during this run were my initial over-strict assertions (upload endpoint payload, wa.me redirect host) which I corrected in the test code.
